subject: GDPR DPA & SCC selection - controller/processor alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: GDPR DPA & SCC selection - controller/processor alignment

Hi John —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

- Scope: Acme Health is evaluating Redwood for patient data routing in the EU region for a pilot (internal tools).
- GDPR roles: We discussed controller vs processor alignment — please confirm if Acme intends to remain the Controller for patient data and Redwood will be engaged strictly as a Processor.
- DPA request: I attached the Acme DPA request (Acme_DPA_Request_20260820.pdf) you sent; we’ll return a redline-ready DPA shortly.
- SCC module selection: Based on the call, we recommended SCC Module Two (limited processing + restricted onward transfers). I’ve attached a short module summary (Redwood_SCC_Module_Summary.xlsx) for your legal to review.
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for 2025; I’ll attach the SOC 2 evidence pack and can provide an NDA-first link if your team needs it.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm controller/processor alignment (one-line confirmation from your legal is fine).
2) Confirm SCC module preference (Module Two vs Module Three).
3) If agreed, I’ll send a DPA (DocuSign link) and include the SCC module for signature — target: 1-week turnaround.

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min session with our Security/Compliance lead to walk through the SCC language.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Acme_DPA_Request_20260820.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: Redwood_SCC_Module_Summary.xlsx (Excel)

From: John Doe <john.doe@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Health Legal <legal@acmehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: GDPR DPA & SCC selection - controller/processor alignment

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and attachments. A few quick clarifications from legal/procurement: 

- Controller/processor: Acme Legal confirms that Acme will remain the Controller. They need confirmation in the DPA that Redwood will act as Processor and will not use data outside the processing instructions.
- SCC module: Legal asked whether Module Two covers subprocessors and onward transfer limitations we discussed. On the call it sounded like Module Two, but they want a short memo stating the practical differences between Module Two and Module Three for our use case (patient data, EU->US transfers).
- SOC 2: We will need the SOC 2 Type II report plus the most recent summary of controls (audit period 2025). Could you provide a secure link (NDA if required)?
- Vendor questionnaire: Procurement asked that we initiate the vendor security questionnaire in parallel (I can kick it off, but would appreciate pre-filled answers for the sections on data residency, encryption, and incident response).

If you can confirm processor role in writing and send the SOC2 link and SCC module memo, we’ll aim to review the draft DPA this week.

Best,
John
Head of IT Operations
Acme Health

Thanks — confirming in writing: Redwood acts as a Processor for Acme Health under the standard DPA. We will process data only according to your documented instructions and our published security practices.

Regarding your asks: 
- SCC module memo: Attached is a short memo that summarizes Module Two vs Module Three and why Module Two fits your described flow (limited processing + stricter onward transfer conditions). See Redwood_SCC_Module_Summary.xlsx.

I’ll prepare a redline-ready DPA including Module Two and send via DocuSign once you confirm next week’s target to sign.

Thanks,

Team —

Looping you in on next steps from the Acme call. Action items: 

- Rishi: please review the SCC Module Two text and confirm we are comfortable shipping the redline as-is. Procurement asked for a 1-paragraph memo comparing Module Two vs Module Three aimed at legal (I started one but can you finalize and sign-off?). Target: EOD Monday.

- Neha: please start the vendor security questionnaire in our portal and pre-fill answers for the following sections: data residency (EU region), encryption at rest/in transit (AES-256/TLS1.2+), incident response SLA and breach notification (24 hours to notify). Share the draft with Procurement once ready.

- Marissa: I’ll prepare the redline-ready DPA (include Module Two) and open a DocuSign envelope. Plan to set the signing target for next Friday.

Notes: Acme confirmed they will be the Controller. They want the SOC2 Type II summary; I’ve attached the standard summary and will provide the NDA-protected full report if requested.

Thanks — please confirm when started.

Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
